resolution: Made the held item the TOP-priority focus, so the properties panel always shows the item you have in focus instead of falling through to an unrelated tile brush. The nonsense the user called out: shownFocus resolved as selCells (tiles) > placeFocus (place layer) > armedFocus (held) > tile brush, so the thing you are actively HOLDING was third in line and could be shadowed by a stale tile/place selection or leak the tile brush (TILE Asphalt). Reordered: armedFocus wins outright, then a tile selection, then the place layer, then the tile brush only as the genuine tile-paint default; focusWorld matches so a held prop resolves against its dressed preview. With req_1959 (held props) + req_1962 (held build pieces get a piece focus), holding ANY catalog item now shows that item uniformly. Verified compiling green. NOT committed: index.tsx also holds another session's uncommitted MINIMAL_REPRO=true probe (req_1980) gating the panels off, and I cannot stage only my lines without shipping their temp probe; per the user's 'let them do their thing' I left my change in the working tree to ride into index.tsx's next commit. Pure logic fix, correct regardless of MINIMAL_REPRO.
